author: THSV StreamBridge
description: Point it at a folder of sounds on this PC; each chat command, channel point reward or Control Panel press plays one of them at random.
changelog: 4.1.156: aligned with THSV StreamBridge 4.1.156, guided wizard UI, verified update metadata, and regenerated Streamer.bot imports. Initial release.

manifest.name: Random Sound
installationSteps: Put your sounds (MP3, WAV, OGG, OPUS, FLAC, M4A or WEBM) in a folder on this PC.
Add a row: a name, the full path of the folder, and optionally a chat command or a Twitch or Kick channel point reward ID.
Add http://127.0.0.1:8787/overlay/addons/thsv.random-sound as a browser source in each scene where sounds should be heard. Add it on one canvas only, so each sound is heard once.
Enable the extension and restart StreamBridge. The Control Panel shows how many sounds each folder has.
uninstallationSteps: Disable the extension and remove its browser source. Your sound folders are never changed.

healthChecks.description: Checks folder matching for commands and rewards, fair random picks without repeats, and cooldowns.
